steps.title: Prepare Work Environment and Slides
steps.instruction: Ensure all surfaces are cleaned with RNAse Away (Ambion, Cat #10328011) and use clean disposable gloves and face masks to limit RNA contamination.

substeps.instruction: Expose 1.2 µm Leica PPS-membrane slides (Leica, Cat# 11505268) to UV light in a tissue culture laminar flow hood (blower off) for 30 minutes immediately prior to cryosectioning.
Store slides at room temperature for optimal tissue adherence.
Label each slide with specimen ID, date, and slide number.
Cool cryostat to -22°C.
Clean work surfaces and install a new cutting blade.
Place a small slide box cleaned with RNAse Away inside the chamber to store freshly cut tissue.

steps.title: Tissue Sectioning
steps.instruction: Adhere kidney tissue preserved in OCT (stored at -80°C) to a tissue holder and equilibrate for a few minutes using a heat extractor to strengthen adhesion.

substeps.instruction: Cut 12 µm sections as follows: 2 sections for Bulk analysis (Eppendorf tube); 8 sections for LMD (affixed to Leica LMD slides, 1 nephrectomy or 2 biopsy sections per slide); 1 section for Periodic acid-Shiff staining (glass slide); 2 sections for miRNA; 6 sections for proteomics (affixed to PEN-membrane LMD slides, 1 nephrectomy or 2 biopsy sections per slide).
Cut 2 sections at 50 µm thickness: store in tissue culture plate with 4% PFA for 24hr, then transfer to scintillation vial with 0.25% PFA for long-term storage at 4°C.
Add a small amount of OCT to cover the specimen at the end of cryosectioning.

steps.title: Slide Storage and Handling
steps.instruction: Store LMD and proteomics slides at -80°C with a desiccant cartridge (Bel-Art, Cat# F42046-0000) inside a tightly closed Ziplock® bag.

substeps.instruction: Use slides within 10 days of cryosectioning.
For external processing, ship specimens overnight (Mon-Thurs) on dry ice.

steps.title: Tissue Staining for LMD
steps.instruction: Perform staining on the tissue sections to identify regions of interest.

substeps.instruction: Apply RNAse-free PBS on top of the tissue, 2X for 30 seconds each.
Apply 10% BSA in RNAse-free PBS, 2X for 30 seconds each.
Apply Ab-Mix (volume based on tissue size) for 5 minutes in the dark.
Apply 10% BSA in RNAse-free PBS, 2X for 30 seconds each.
If LRP2 is used, apply Secondary antibody for 4 minutes, followed by 10% BSA in RNAse-free PBS, 2X for 30 seconds each.
Air-dry the slide for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Laser Microdissection (LMD)
steps.instruction: Load slides onto the Leica Laser MicroDissection platform and perform dissection.

substeps.instruction: Limit each LMD session to 2 hours to minimize RNA degradation.
Collect pre- and post-LMD immunofluorescence images using Leica DFC7000T camera.
Dissect a minimum of 500,000 µm² area per sub-segment to obtain 0.5–1 ng of RNA (may require up to 8 x 12 µm sections).

Identify regions based on criteria: Proximal tubule (OG-Phalloidin/LRP2), Thick ascending loop (THP), Collecting duct (PNA lectin), Distal convoluted tubule (OG-Phalloidin/morphology, absence of LRP2/THP/PNA), Glomerulus (OG-Phalloidin/morphology, include bowman’s capsule), Cortical Tubulointerstitium (neighboring glomerulus), Interstitium (area between stained tubules).
Maximize dissection of 3-4 segments per slide, prioritizing scarce segments (collecting duct, DCT, glomeruli).
Ensure PT and TAL are not collected together due to shared secondary Ab.

steps.title: RNA Extraction and Purification
steps.instruction: Process the collected LMD samples for RNA purification.

substeps.instruction: Close collecting microcentrifuge tubes, flick vigorously to move content to bottom, and centrifuge at 3,000 rcf for 30 seconds.
Incubate tubes in 42°C water bath for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge at 3,000 rcf for 2 minutes and transfer supernatant to a new 0.5 mL tube; store at -80°C.
Add 250 µL Conditioned Buffer (CB) to each RNA purification column (PC), incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature, and centrifuge for 1 minute at 16,000 rcf.
Add 50 µL 70% Ethanol to tissue samples, mix by pipetting (do not vortex or centrifuge).
Transfer mixture to conditioned PCs; centrifuge for 2 minutes at 100 rcf, then 30 seconds at 16,000 rcf. Repeat if multiple tubes are used per subsegment.
Add 100 µL Wash Buffer 1 (WB1), centrifuge for 1 minute at 8,000 rcf; then add 40 µL WB1 to membrane, centrifuge for 15 seconds at 8,000 rcf.
Add 100 µL Wash Buffer 2 (WB2), centrifuge for 1 minute at 8,000 rcf; then add 100 µL WB2 to membrane, centrifuge for 2 minutes at 16,000 rcf, followed by 1 minute at 16,000 rcf.
Transfer PC to a new 0.5 mL tube, add 12 µL Elution Buffer (EB), and incubate for 7 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 1,000 rcf, then 2 minutes at 16,000 rcf.
Transfer 2 µL to a fresh tube for Bioanalyzer analysis; store all tubes at -80°C.

steps.title: RNA Sequencing and Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform library preparation and sequencing on the purified RNA.

substeps.instruction: Verify QC: Bulk quantity > 4 ng; Subsegment quantity 0.5-1 ng; DV200 > 25% (optimal > 75%).
Perform library prep using Takara SMARTer Stranded Total RNA-Seq pico input v2 (Option 2).
Add Illumina Adapters and Indexes.
Deplete Ribosomal cDNA with ZapR v2 and R-Probes v2.
Purify final library using AMPure Beads (2 ng/µl cDNA concentration).
Sequence 75 bp paired end on Illumina NovoSeq (30 million reads/sample for bulk, 100 million for subsegments).
Include Takara Clonetech qPCR Human Reference Total RNA (25 ng, Cat #636690) as a separate sample in each run.
Analyze data with FastQC, perform quantile normalization, and quantify expression as a log2-transformed ratio of sub-segment to average of others.

steps.title: Proteomics Sample Preparation (FFPE)
steps.instruction: Prepare paraffin-embedded sections for mass spectrometry.

substeps.instruction: Collect 10 µm paraffin sections in mass spec clean container with mass spec H2O (heated in water bath).
Air dry slides, then place in desiccator with desiccant stones under vacuum for 7 days.
Deparaffinize: 3 changes of octane (2 min each), 3 changes of absolute ethanol (2 min each), 1 change 90% ethanol (2 min), 1 change 70% ethanol (2 min), and 2 changes of H2O (2 min each).
Stain with hematoxylin for 2-5 seconds, rinse in 2 changes of H2O (2 min each).
Rehydrate/Dehydrate: 1 change 70% ethanol (2 min), 1 change 95% ethanol (2 min), 2 changes absolute ethanol (2 min each). Air dry for LMD.

Alternative/Optional staining: 70% Ethanol (2x 2 min, one at 4°C), MS grade water (2x 2 min), Hematoxylin QS stain, MS grade water (2x 30 sec), 70% ethanol (2 min), 95% ethanol (2 min), 100% ethanol (2x 2 min).

steps.title: Proteomics LMD and Digestion
steps.instruction: Perform LMD and protein extraction for mass spectrometry.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 0.5% Rapigest: add 200 µL of 50 mM NH3HCO3 to a 0.2 mg Rapigest tube, swirl 20-30 seconds.
Use 25 µL of 0.5% Rapigest to collect LMPC samples via LMD (Leica DFC7000T), collecting ~20,000 cells in under 2 hours.
Freeze samples in PCR tubes using dry ice and store at -80°C.
Cut off cap sides, place 0.2 mL tubes into 1.5 mL tubes (bottom cut off), secure with 10 µL pipet tip.
Boil sample for 20 minutes (incubate at 60°C for 2 hours for FFPE only).
Cool and add trypsin (200 ng/µl in 50 mM NH3HCO3) at 1:30 ratio, centrifuge at 13,000 RPM, and incubate overnight at 37°C.
Add formic acid to a final volume of 30% (ensure cloudiness), incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge 3X at 15,000 RPM, collecting supernatant away from pellet.
Speedvac dry sample and examine for amber pellet.
Add 20 µL 2% Acetonitrile, 0.1% formic acid, vortex and centrifuge briefly.
Place in ice cold sonicating water bath for 1 minute, then centrifuge briefly.
Check peptide concentration via Nanodrop (280 nm absorbance).
Load 1.5 µg of peptides onto a 25 cm Magic C18 AQ 100 Å reverse-phase column (75 μm ID) with an IntegraFrit Capillary trap (100 μm ID, 2 cm Magic C18 AQ 200 Å).
Separate using 0.1% formic acid in water (A) and 0.1% formic acid in acetonitrile (B) at 300 nl/min over a 163-min gradient: 2-50% B (5-30% B for 2.5h, 30-50% B for 10 min, 50% B for 3 min).
Operate mass spectrometer in data dependent MS/MS mode (m/z 400–1,500), resolution 120,000, AGC target 2 x 10^5, injection time 50 ms.
For MS2: Quadrupole isolation window 1.6 m/z, cycle time 3 s, charge state 2-6, 27% normalized HCD collision energy, ion trap AGC target 1 x 10^4, injection time 90 ms, dynamic exclusion 20s.
Set enzyme as Trypsin (max 2 missed cleavages), precursor tolerance 10 ppm, fragment tolerance 0.6 Da.
Set variable modifications: carbamidomethyl on cysteine and oxidation of methionine.
Score results via Percolator (1% peptide-level FDR, q value 0.01) and report proteins with FDR ≤ 1%.

steps.title: Mass Spectrometer Calibration and QC
steps.instruction: Maintain instrument performance through regular calibration.

substeps.instruction: Perform mass calibration weekly (< 3 ppm accuracy) and full calibration monthly.
Daily/Intermittent QC: Inject five-peptide standard (500 fmol each). Criteria: retention time deviation < 1 min, mass accuracy < 3 ppm, resolution > 120,000 at m/z 200.
Post-calibration QC: Inject 500 ng trypsin-digested yeast lysate; minimum 3000 proteins must be identified (< 1% FDR).

description: Antibody validation: All primary and secondary antibodies are validated either by CLIA or GUDMAP citation, or by internal validation. Internal validation means meeting Human Protein Atlas standards. The minimum level for Ab validation is orthogonal data supporting its specificity.
